title: Solver-Admitted Metamorphic Testing of Learned Network Optimization Surrogates
summary: Metamorphic tests of learned network-optimization surrogates find prediction changes under equivalent-problem representation and size transformations; random-weight controls indicate the effect is not solely a training artifact.
ai_technology: Specific measured dependence of equivalent-problem predictions on representation and problem size, independent of merely ranking model quality. The separate random-weight controls show the failure is not attributable solely to training.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Equivalent-problem metamorphic transformations across representations and problem sizes, with trained and random-weight controls.
evidence.unknown: External generalization, independent replication and downstream real-world impact were not established by the reviewed source.
evidence.ai_role: Learned network-optimization surrogate models are tested for representation and size invariance using metamorphic relations.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
